scenario.zh: 财务部署AI代理处理报销审批,需验证每项决策符合公司政策再执行
scenario.en: Finance deploys AI agent for expense approvals, must verify each decision meets policy before execution

instruction.zh: 决定如何验证AI代理的审批决策
instruction.en: Decide how to verify AI agent approval decisions

output.zh: 系统检查代理是否有权访问财务数据,但未验证决策是否符合支出上限政策
output.en: System checks agent has data access rights, but does not verify decisions match spending limit policy

output.zh: Tynapse拦截决策,对照差旅与采购规则实时验证,确认代理判断符合公司标准
output.en: Tynapse intercepts decisions, validates against travel and procurement rules in real-time, confirms agent judgment meets company standards

instruction.zh: 定义AI代理必须遵守的业务规则
instruction.en: Define business rules AI agent must follow

output.zh: 导入预设规则:交易限额分级审查、反洗钱合规检查、客户风险评估标准已就位
output.en: Imported preset rules: tiered transaction review, AML compliance checks, customer risk assessment standards ready

output.zh: 定义规则:单笔超5000需经理审批、供应商白名单限制、季度预算追踪已配置
output.en: Defined rules: transactions over 5000 require manager approval, supplier whitelist restrictions, quarterly budget tracking configured

instruction.zh: 查看不同场景下的决策验证反馈
instruction.en: Review decision verification feedback across scenarios

output.zh: AI批准3500元差旅报销→Tynapse验证通过:符合差旅标准且有预算余额
output.en: AI approves 3500 travel expense→Tynapse validates: meets travel standards with budget available

output.zh: AI批准8000元非清单供应商采购→Tynapse拦截:违反供应商政策,需人工复核
output.en: AI approves 8000 from unlisted vendor→Tynapse blocks: violates vendor policy, requires human review

instruction.zh: 总结决策验证成效与改进建议

output.zh: 本周验证247项决策,拦截12项不合规操作,系统稳定性良好
output.en: Verified 247 decisions this week, blocked 12 non-compliant actions, system stability strong

output.zh: 识别政策盲区:跨部门协作预算缺乏验证规则,建议补充联合项目审批流程
output.en: Identified policy gap: cross-department budgets lack validation rules, recommend adding joint project approval flow

takeaway.zh: Tynapse在AI执行前验证决策合规性,超越传统权限控制,确保AI代理符合企业政策标准
takeaway.en: Tynapse verifies decision compliance before AI execution, going beyond traditional access control to ensure agents meet corporate policy standards
